notes: BUU v3.0.5 - your data is now safe from installers. The uninstaller NEVER deletes flows, logs, failures, or schedules - on any path (in-app update, manually-run installer, or real uninstall; on 7/17 a manual install wiped them). Data parks to C:\BUU-preserved and restores automatically; the in-app updater also backs up flows+schedules to the app data folder first. The update check times out after 15s instead of hanging and names exactly what failed. Start mode saves with each flow - saved as Run all, it runs unattended every time including schedules; older flows load as Run all. The schedules picker explains itself when empty.
